name: fullPage Vertical & Horizontal Slider – Snap Scroll Sections & More
author: meceware

sections.description:
fullPage Vertical & Horizontal Slider allows you to design smooth-scrolling, full-screen websites with ease. Using the powerful fullPage.js library, this plugin integrates seamlessly into WordPress, enabling users to create beautiful, engaging layouts with minimal effort.

Features

  • Fully responsive design for a seamless experience across all devices.
  • Smooth touch support for mobile, tablet, and touchscreen devices.
  • Simple section and slide creation.
  • Full-page scrolling with an optional visible scrollbar.
  • Auto-height sections for dynamic content.
  • Animated anchor links for seamless navigation.
  • Configurable section and slide looping.
  • Built-in keyboard navigation support.
  • Browser history support for back-button navigation.
  • Horizontal and vertical navigation controls with various styling options.
  • Optional responsive scrollbar that adapts to different screen sizes.

Usage

For detailed setup instructions, visit the documentation.

  1. Create a new page or post.
  2. Add the FullPage for Gutenberg block (ensure no other content exists in the post/page).
  3. By default, two sections will be created. You can add more sections or slides using the buttons inside the block.
  4. Customize each section/slide with your content.
  5. Adjust settings by selecting the desired block and modifying its properties.
  6. Remove sections or slides using the delete icon.

🚫 Limitations

The free version of fullPage.js for Gutenberg is a great way to get started, but it comes with some limitations compared to the full experience:

  • ❌ Limited to 4 vertical sections and 1 horizontal slide section (up to 3 slides only)
  • ❌ No access to premium extensions and effects, like:
    • Parallax scrolling
    • Advanced sliding transition effects
    • Horizontal scrolling via mouse wheel
    • Fading Effect
    • Infinite Horizontal Scroll
    • Drag and move
    • And more…
  • ❌ No responsive options (different behaviors on mobile/tablet)
  • ❌ No support for scrollable elements inside sections (modals, maps, canva…)
  • ❌ No easing animations (all movements use default timing)
  • ❌ No support included

🚀 Unlock the full experience

Upgrade to the premium version to get:

  • ✅ Unlimited sections & slides
  • ✅ Access to paid extensions and advanced effects (purchased separately)
  • ✅ Access to powerful methods and callback events
  • ✅ Responsive settings, lazy loading, and enhanced navigation & more
  • ✅ Priority support and regular updates

👉 Get the premium version →

External Services

This plugin allows users to embed background videos in their sections. If users choose to use videos hosted on YouTube, the following applies:

  • YouTube: The plugin may load YouTube’s player API (https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api) to enable video playback. No data is sent to YouTube unless the user explicitly embeds a YouTube video.

Development

This plugin includes JavaScript and CSS files. The source code for these files is publicly available:

  • iwideo.js
  • fullPage.js Limited
